title: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Learning via Subchunk Rollouts in Latent World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.27645v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can improve pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies through imagined experiences. However, existing VLA-MBRL methods primarily rely on large-scale image or video generation world models, incurring large computational overhead. Latent world models offer a more efficient alternative but face two challenges: compounding errors during recursive prediction and incompatibility with VLAs' visual input interfaces. In this work, we propose LS-MBPO, a lightweight residual MBRL framework that leverages latent world models to improve upon pretrained VLAs. LS-MBPO introduces two key techniques: (1) Hierarchical Forcing, which combines dense causal supervision with autoregressive feedback to mitigate compounding prediction errors; and (2) Latent Subchunk Rollouts, which leverage action chunks from a frozen VLA policy and a latent residual policy for successive subchunk refinement, bridging the gap bet

translated_title: 基于潜在世界模型子块推演的高效VLA强化学习
translated_abstract: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）能够通过想象经验来改进预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。然而，现有的VLA-MBRL方法主要依赖大规模的图像或视频生成世界模型，会产生巨大的计算开销。潜在世界模型提供了一种更高效的替代方案，但面临两个挑战：递归预测过程中的复合误差累积，以及与VLA视觉输入接口的不兼容性。在本工作中，我们提出LS-MBPO，一个轻量级的残差MBRL框架，利用潜在世界模型来改进预训练的VLA策略。LS-MBPO引入了两项关键技术：（1）层级强制，将密集的因果监督与自回归反馈相结合，以缓解预测误差的复合累积；（2）潜在子块推演，利用冻结VLA策略的动作块和潜在残差策略进行连续的子块优化，从而弥合了……
tldr: 该论文提出LS-MBPO轻量级残差MBRL框架，通过层级强制缓解复合预测误差、并通过潜在子块推演结合冻结VLA策略与潜在残差策略，从而以低计算开销的潜在世界模型高效改进预训练VLA策略。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LS-MBPO, a lightweight residual MBRL framework that leverages latent world models with Hierarchical Forcing and Latent Subchunk Rollouts to efficiently improve pretrained VLA policies with low computational overhead.
